downstream_outcomes.evidence_summary: Recipient says profile may fit the collaboration under evaluation, asks for 1-2 concrete support-ticket examples, availability, response model, pricing, ticketing experience and OTOBO/OTRS/Znuny familiarity, and states that a short call can follow once this information is reviewed.

manual_apply_examples: Moonshot — freelance Web Developer pool via platform
Advertage — current WordPress/PHP/eCommerce role routed through application platform
reject_examples: UGECE Agency — direct email exists but freelance WordPress need is about six months old; freshness gate fails
Kapetan — freelance website developer application deadline passed 2026-08-30
Aleide — permanent/in-office role rather than external-capacity fit
Kalyma/White-label providers — sellers of the same capacity, no verified current buying signal

development_changes.change: Buyer-intent ranker now prevents generic corporate vacancies containing weak words such as partner/collaboration from being promoted to AGENCY_EXTERNAL_CAPACITY without explicit freelance/white-label/overflow/subcontracting/external-capacity evidence.

notes: Zero new first-contact send is acceptable in this cycle because fresh direct-email harvesting was performed, all viable email routes found were duplicates or stale, and the cycle produced a qualified positive reply materially advancing the funnel. No reply was sent automatically to NextGen because continuation replies require user review and explicit approval.
